name: GetLeads
summary: B2B contact and company database with structured search, counts, async CSV exports, and person and company enrichment.

api_key.description: a GetLeads API key like glb_live_<keyId>_<secret> (app.getleads.io/api-keys)

notes: Rate limit: 100 requests per minute per account, shared across keys; a 429 carries Retry-After.

One plan credit buys one returned record, not one email. Counts, column catalogues and enum values are free. A genuine enrichment no-match should not use a credit. HTTP 402 means the credit or fair-use budget is spent.
Search is POST with filters in the body, flat or inside a filters object. Different filters AND together; values in one list OR together. Check audience size with the free count endpoint first.
A stored work email is not necessarily verified: email_status VALID is verified, CATCH_ALL and UNKNOWN are not. Reverify before sending.
Async export flow: POST an export (up to 50,000 rows) to get export_id, poll the matching GET until job_status is completed or failed, then download export_url (temporary, about 7 days).
Enrichment endpoints take items, up to 100 people per request. CSV enrichment (multipart) and the company followers, profile monitoring and visitor identification products are not in this entry.
The reverse phone lookup routes answer 410 (pending).
